rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is emotionally unfeeling and indifferent to others' suffering.

example.english: He was callous enough to make sarcastic remarks to the injured person.
example.traditional: 佢對住傷者仲講風涼話，真係冷血。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 soeng1 ze2 zung6 gong2 fung1 loeng4 waa2 zan1 hai6 laang5 hyut3

rows.note: Use this when calling someone's behaviour cruel or inhumane, especially when it causes obvious suffering.

example.english: It was callous of him to drive the patient out of the hospital just to save money.
example.traditional: 為咗慳錢，佢竟然將病人趕出醫院，真係冇人性。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 haan1 cin2 keoi5 ging2 jin4 zoeng1 beng6 jan4 gon2 ceot1 ji1 jyun2 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 sing3

rows.note: Use this softer choice when stressing a lack of warmth, sympathy, or human feeling rather than outright cruelty.

example.english: It was callous of him to ask when I would repay him even though he knew I was unemployed.
example.traditional: 佢明知我失業，仲問我幾時還錢，真係冇人情味。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 zi1 ngo5 sat1 jip6 zung6 man6 ngo5 gei2 si4 waan4 cin2 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 cing4 mei6
